question: What is the meaning of density in relation to material layers, materials?
description: Density is the mass per unit volume of a material. In the context of material layers and materials, it is used to determine the weight of the materials present within a structure. This weight can aid in assessing the potential for reuse, among other applications. For example, in the case of CLT (Cross Laminated Timber) and EPS (Expanded Polystyrene) insulation, their densities are mentioned to evaluate their environmental impacts and recycling potential. The lower the density, the lower the mass and potentially the better the recycling potential.
